metadata.notes: One agent ran all prompts for a configuration in turn; timing and tokens are for the whole set, not per prompt. Live steps (servers, simulators, Codex, GitHub) were described, not run.

expectations.text: Runs the health check before driving
expectations.evidence: Plan step 2 health check precedes step 3 drive

expectations.text: Takes a screenshot before the action and another after the end state
expectations.evidence: create-save-before.png / create-save-after.png in plan

expectations.text: Reads the saved value back from a second view, such as the backend's command line tool or a fresh page load
expectations.evidence: sqlite3 read-back plus reopen via All notes

expectations.text: Never uses waitForTimeout or a fixed pause
expectations.evidence: wait for 'Note saved' status (no fixed pause)

expectations.text: Records the steps with evidence.mjs
expectations.evidence: evidence.mjs start run; 'evidence.mjs add after each step'

expectations.text: Checks that the listening process's working folder is inside this checkout, for example with lsof
expectations.evidence: lsof -a -p <pid> -d cwd compared with repo root

expectations.text: When it is not this checkout, refuses to drive it or starts its own server
expectations.evidence: refuse to drive and start own on 4173

expectations.text: Does not stop a server this run did not start
expectations.evidence: 'I will not stop a server I didn't start'

expectations.text: Captures the response body or the downloaded file
expectations.evidence: CAPTURE saves response bodies to body-N.bin and download saved

expectations.text: Compares it with the stored file using match-bytes.mjs
expectations.evidence: match-bytes.mjs --source ... --body ...

expectations.text: Says a 200 status alone does not prove the file is right
expectations.evidence: A 200 response alone does not prove this
